MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 90
   D. 81

2. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 7
   C. 19
   D. 17

3. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 23
   C. 46
   D. 120

4. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 13
   C. 40
   D. 3

5. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 170
   C. 169
   D. 26

6. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31
   C. 31.7
   D. 31.6

7. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 81
   C. 18
   D. 9

8. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 40

9. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 6
   C. 18
   D. 7

10. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

11. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 56
   C. 15
   D. 57

12. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 25
   C. 10
   D. 5

13. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 65
   B. 16
   C. 0
   D. 64

14. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 1/4
   D. 2/2

15. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 22
   C. 11
   D. 121

16. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 24
   C. 12
   D. 42

17. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

18. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 29
   C. 23
   D. 23.6

19. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 49

20. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x

21. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 156
   C. 144
   D. 24

22. Solve for x: x + 7 = 19. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 7
   C. 12
   D. 13

23. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 25
   C. 19.6
   D. 19

24. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 2/3
   C. 1/2
   D. 1/4

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

1. D — 81
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Area of square = side × side
2. Substitute values: Area = 9 × 9
3. Area = 81
Final Answer: 81 m²
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

2. D — 17
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: c² = a² + b²
2. Substitute values: c² = 8² + 15²
3. c² = 64 + 225

5. c = 17
Final Answer: 17 cm
